title: SAICA ITC South Africa
issuer: South African Institute of Chartered Accountants
outline_source: SAICA Initial Test of Competence (ITC) public syllabus domains (Financial Accounting and Reporting; Audit and Assurance; Taxation; Managerial Accounting and Finance)
content_provenance: Domain names reflect the public SAICA ITC syllabus areas covered by the authored practice bundle, which follows the flagship domain weighting (Financial Accounting and Reporting 20, Audit and Assurance 14, Taxation 14, Managerial Accounting and Finance 12). Item topics are covered in the authored practice bundle; this file is not a certified statement of the awarding body's syllabus.

objectives.text: IAS 16 Property, Plant and Equipment and IAS 40 Investment Property
IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers
IAS 2 Inventories and IAS 36 Impairment of Assets
IAS 37 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
IFRS 16 Leases and IFRS 9 Financial Instruments
IAS 12 Income Taxes, IAS 21 and IAS 10 Events after the Reporting Period
IFRS 3 Business Combinations, IFRS 10 Consolidation and IAS 28 Associates
IAS 33 Earnings per Share, IAS 7 and IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements
Companies Act 71 of 2008 financial reporting and audit requirements
Public interest score and statutory reporting obligations
ISA 200 overall objectives and ISA 315 risk assessment
ISA 320 materiality and ISA 500 audit evidence
ISA 505 external confirmations and ISA 520 analytical procedures
ISA 700, ISA 705 and ISA 570 reporting and going concern
ISA 230 audit documentation and ISA 610 using internal auditors
SAICA Code of Professional Conduct and independence threats
ISA 240 fraud responsibilities and the Companies Act audit requirement
Gross income definition and section 11(a) general deduction formula
Section 12C wear and tear allowances and corporate tax rates
Small business corporations, assessed losses and provisional tax
Employees' tax, dividends tax, donations tax and estate duty
VAT Act 89 of 1991 output tax, zero-rated and exempt supplies
Eighth Schedule capital gains tax inclusion rates
Cost-volume-profit analysis, break-even and contribution margin
Marginal versus absorption costing and overhead absorption
Standard costing price and efficiency variances
Relevant costing, limiting factors and inventory management
Net present value and payback capital budgeting
Weighted average cost of capital
